answer: A grove roll-call stops fake agents. Each applicant binds one non-transferable pulse seal to one device and joins a grove. Verifiers broadcast a bridge challenge every identity must answer in the same window. A missing or duplicated pulse burns the seal and slashes its cluster. The k-th fake costs 90+20k units for a live operator, so cost grows with n and cannot be reused; verifiers enforce it and failure loses seal and stake. One fake costs 110, 1,000 cost 10,100,000. A rented farm fails: one operator cannot answer many pulse challenges. Honest agents answer once.
